headline: Shipping Scout, learning Rust, reading slowly.

blocks.title: Building
blocks.body: Putting the finishing touches on Scout v1 — annotation sync, weekly digests, and a calmer onboarding. Most days look like a slow loop of writing, deleting, and writing again.
items: Weekly digest email — opt-in, no metrics
Migration path for the v0 users

blocks.title: Learning
blocks.body: Working through Crafting Interpreters in Rust. Half the joy is forgetting what I knew about parsers and rebuilding the intuition.
items: A second pass through Designing Data-Intensive Applications

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.body: Slowly, deliberately. The list below is roughly what I'm between right now.
items: Pilgrim at Tinker Creek — Annie Dillard

blocks.title: Outside
blocks.body: Long walks in the morning, espresso in the afternoon. Trying to read fewer things faster and more things slowly.
